why: The migration issue #324's step S4 performs, written as the shortcut that would have made it invisible: keep the old source working beside the new one. Both payloads carry `attempt` counts, so a fallback still renders a plausible summary line -- built from the Records table's numbers, pushed by an application route, onto a panel a gameplay session owns. Every test that pushes an outcome passes under it, which is why the split needs an assertion of its own: the discriminating case is a HUD told ONLY the Records numbers, and that HUD must show no summary at all. Re-anchored when the line's body moved into the shared `tallyLineEl` helper: the mutation now adds the Records-payload fallback as a branch rather than swapping the source expression, which is the same defect through the shape the code has today.
killedBy: hud: the stats page the attempt summary reads the outcome projection, NOT the Records table it used to ride
